title: Murder of Pradyuman Thakur
narrative: FIR — Murder of Pradyuman Thakur, Ryan International School, Gurugram, Haryana. On 8 September 2017, Pradyuman Thakur, a seven-year-old student, was found with his throat slit with a knife outside a washroom at the Ryan International School and later died of his injuries. The Gurugram police initially arrested a school bus conductor, Ashok Kumar, but he was exonerated after the CBI took over the investigation and charged a sixteen-year-old student of the same school with the murder. Four police officers were later charged with framing the bus conductor.
